content: A 1/4" drive, 7/32" or 5.5mm hex socket on a universal-joint adapter is also helpful in this step. The Prusa alignment tool helps get the nut started, but does not allow enough torque to tighten.

My alignment tool was black not Prusa orange, Sad reacts ;-(. the depressions for the but were not crisp and tight leading to the nut spinning. you "can" get the universal tool in there instead. so much fun !! not
